Duloxetine first time
I started taking Duloxetine for pain I have (fibromyalgia).  At the first week starting dosage of 30mg/day it didn't seem to do a whole lot.  But the first few days of the 60mg/day dosage felt like the aftereffects of an Ecstacy trip.  I noticed I felt kinda funny the first morning and then my girlfriend said that my eyes were all dilated.
It is a nice relaxing feeling, but definitely feels somewhat speedy.  It is the type of thing where I am trying to decide if it is good or bad...and then finally decide that it is a bit of both.
Also, I tried to chew up just a few (<10) of the pellets inside the capsule and it made my tongue numb for quite a while.  I think crushing up a whole capsule would be very unpleasant.
It also seems to make hydrocodone somewhat less effective.  I think this is because it moderately inhibits CYP2D6, which is the enzyme that metabolizes hydrocodone.
